validation_points: context.params[jss::feature].isString() - Validates 'feature' is a string if present
table.find(...) and feature.parseHex(...) - Validates 'feature' is a known name or valid hex
context.role == Role::ADMIN - Validates admin role for 'vetoed' param
table.getJson(feature, isAdmin) - Validates feature exists and is accessible

flow: feature.parseHex(...) if not found by name
transformations: Looked up by name in AmendmentTable
Parsed as hex if not found by name
Used to fetch feature info as JSON

test_coverage_notes: Typical test coverage for this handler would be in RPC integration and unit tests, e.g., 'server_info', 'feature', or 'amendment' RPC test files. Tests should cover: (1) valid/invalid 'feature' param (string, missing, bad hex), (2) admin/non-admin 'vetoed' param, (3) correct error codes for bad input, (4) correct output for valid requests. Gaps may exist if tests do not cover all error branches (e.g., non-string 'feature', invalid hex, non-admin vetoed, missing feature in getJson). Look for test files like 'rpc_feature_test.cpp', 'server_info_test.cpp', or similar in the test suite.

validates: Ensures 'feature' parameter is a string if present
Checks if 'feature' matches a known feature name
If not, attempts to parse as hex feature ID
Ensures only admin users can set 'vetoed' field
Coerces 'vetoed' to boolean (no explicit error, but type is enforced by usage)
Checks that the feature exists in the amendment table
